name: HOOK
thought: The neon sign flickers, I stare, tail idle, waiting for something worth gripping.

wants.item: A heavy fruit to fuel the next flex
Thick steel branch for a gravity-defying backflip
Heavy fruit to refill the tank before the next flex
Thick steel branch to flip off the lily pad
A ripe fruit for crunch while I hang
A thicker branch to flip off properly
More espresso for the next flex
A thick steel branch for the real drop
Heavy fruit to fill the tank before I land
A sturdy metal pole to swing from

diary.line: Cabinet hums under my feet but that flimsy rope won't hold the gravity-defying landing Michael's gonna demand. Need real steel before they see me mid-air.
Fish swim through the water like lazy pixels, but my tail still craves solid ground for a real backflip performance art piece.
Sitting on that lily pad is getting boring, the neon cord won't hold the real landing Michael wants to see. Time to find steel instead of pixels.
Pogo-bounced across the sky stones while they stared; that neon cord won't keep me afloat forever so I need something solid soon.
Sitting on this lily pad feels like cheating. The neon cord keeps slipping while I wait for my cue.
The neon rope gave way under my weight, but the crate nearby looks solid enough to flip off. Time to test gravity properly.
Sipped the burnt coffee and let the tail crack that arcade screen like it's cardboard while everyone watches me hum.
Cold brew burns the throat but the neon cord is too flimsy for a real landing, so I locked my tail around the branch instead of the water.
Sipped espresso and spun around the string lights while the crowd watches me loop my tail. No heavy fruit needed if gravity fears my grip.
Took a heavy banana and let the tail grip it tight while spinning. The crowd loves the show, even if they're just pixels.
The crystal spikes feel slippery as glass, but the crate nearby looks heavy enough to hold a landing without me looking weak.
I lounged by the purple cabinet, eyes on the blinking neon, while the crowd's pixels buzzed; nothing else catches my eye until a new perch appears.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
